Chapter 6557: We Can Talk

Chapter 6557: We Can Talk

The two overlords confronted each other in outer space; their auras still suffocated those living in Heaven World.

This hiding spot was immensely far away, separated by one dimension after another and hidden behind galaxies.

Those below couldn’t see them and only felt their monstrous auras. Emperors and desolate gods only saw silhouettes; only primal ancestors and heaven-slayers had a good view.

Xian Chengtian didn’t move but his three dao alone displayed his terrifying might - able to pull or crush Heaven World.

Primal Yin Immortal Ghost, on the other hand, only wanted to run. Thus, he recalled his aura and breath, wanting to fuse with space and become the void. None would notice his presence without Xian Chengtian’s interference.

Everyone became confused about Xian Chengtian’s motive due to a lack of animosity. Moreover, he left himself in the open for ambushers wanting to silence him.

“Dao Brother, what is your business?” The ghost asked.

“I want the source of desires.” Xian Chengtian spoke directly.

The ghost’s expression changed as he took a deep breath: “I’m afraid I don’t have what you’re looking for. My cultivation improved after breaking a bottleneck, resulting in an eruption.”

“Luminous, enough of this. I know your cultivation too well. Who did you ask for help and guidance when you went mad? Who planned all the details for you?” Chengtian spoke with disdain.

Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers became frozen upon hearing the name “Luminous”.

The ancient progenitors shuddered in astonishment.

“He, he’s Luminous Master?” One of them asked.

Although they didn’t dare to comment on the secrets of overlords, this was too much to handle.

“How did he become Primal Yin Immortal Ghost?” An ancient ancestor from Old World asked.

They knew about the founder of Luminous Creek - a brilliant progenitor capable of inheriting a great legacy.

Later on, his lineage was destroyed and its members were massacred in one night. Now, he was still alive but under a different identity?

“What happened?” The ancestors had too many questions.

“No wonder this person has always been mysterious. So this is his background.” A primal ancestor whispered.

The ghost’s expression darkened after his secret was revealed. Despite being an overlord, he didn’t appreciate others bringing up his past.

“Dao Brother, should we talk this out?” He seemed sincere, not wanting to make this public.

“We can talk right here.” Chengtian insisted. His dao harmony remained and his expression looked normal. The only one annoyed was the ghost cultivator.

“I’m listening.” The ghost wanted to avoid escalation at all costs.

“It is time for you to repay your debt. Hand the source over.” Chengtian said.

“Brother, you know this source has my desires and is fused with me. I cannot hand it over so if you need something else, we can discuss.” The ghost said.

“Luminous, I’m not looking down on you but I care not for your trash. I only want the source.” Although his message was threatening, his supreme appearance still looked dignified.

Despite his clarification, he had the right to look down on Primal Yin Immortal Ghost. After all, he was the disciple of three immortals and had no lack of treasures.

Although the ghost came from a famous dao lineage that had reigned over Three Immortals, there was an insurmountable gap in their background.

Nevertheless, the blatant disrespect left the ghost furious.
